message.title: Ex Dividend NOK 4.00 Per Share Today
message.body:
Ålesund, 7 August 2026: 

The shares in Golden Energy Offshore Services ASA will be traded ex dividend of NOK 4.00 per share as of today, 7 August 2026. The payment will be made on or about 14 August 2026.

For further information, please contact:

Per Ivar Fagervoll 
CEO
pif@geoff.no 
Mobile: + 47 974 28 884

This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations and section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.
